summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Nairobi Steel Works landing page. All 8 backend pytest tests pass (root, status, /api/quote create+validation+list). All frontend flows verified: hero CTAs scroll, navbar links, portfolio filters (All/Gates/Balconies), contact form submission with success toast, WhatsApp FAB wa.me link, Google Maps iframe, mobile menu toggle + navigation. End-to-end integration (form -> POST /api/quote -> Mongo persistence) confirmed.

minor.issue: logger is referenced inside create_quote() before logger=logging.getLogger() is defined at module bottom (line 113 vs use at line 86). Works at runtime due to late binding, but ordering is brittle — should declare logger before routes.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` in /app/backend/server.py above the route definitions to avoid late-binding fragility.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger defined after routes that use it (line 113 vs reference at line 86). Currently works due to Python late-name resolution, but should be reordered.
Backend server.py is small (<120 lines), single-file structure is acceptable for this MVP.
Frontend components correctly use process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and data-testid attributes are well-placed on all interactive elements.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via projection in both GET endpoints.
Pydantic validation on QuoteRequestCreate is strong (EmailStr + min_length). Returns proper 422 on bad inputs.
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); could migrate to lifespan handler in future.
seed_data_creation: Test quote requests inserted via POST /api/quote with TEST_ prefixed names and random emails (test_<uuid>@example.com). Test status_checks inserted with TEST_<uuid> client_name.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (8 tests, all pass). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://metalworks-ke.preview.emergentagent.com. All UI elements have data-testid prefixes (hero-*, nav-link-*, portfolio-filter-*, portfolio-item-*, form-*, whatsapp-fab, mobile-menu-*, contact-*). Quote endpoint persists to MongoDB collection quote_requests. No auth required.
